rationale: The stock gapped up ~9% on strong earnings beat and is trading at 75% of today's range with elevated relative volume (7.71x), but the first candle shows extreme intraday volatility (L=$19.68 to H=$21.42) indicating price discovery is still chaotic and unstable. The wide bid-ask spread (80.9 bps) and the whipsaw action in the opening candles make reliable entry/exit levels difficult to define with confidence. With 4 working orders already deployed and the setup lacking a clean directional structure post-gap, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
